messages:
Ava (CEO): Thanks everyone for joining today — leaving this thread open for follow-up Qs about the reorg and headcount plan. post anything here and leadership will chime in.
Priya (Head of Product): Quick note — the product org changes are intended to align teams by platform vs. feature. Main goal: fewer cross-team handoffs for infra/serving features.
Diego (VP Eng): To add: Eng reshuffle = 4 squads -> 3 platform-aligned pods, one new reliability pod. No layoffs. We're reallocating ~12 ICs over next 8 weeks.
Evan (People Ops): Hiring update: we have approvals for 18 new roles this FY, prioritized as: infra (6), ML infra (4), backend (4), product (2), support (2). We're pushing to post JD's this week for top 8.
Jared (Eng Manager): Can you clarify whether the 12 reassigned ICs are voluntary moves or manager-driven? Heads need to coordinate 1:1s.
Diego (VP Eng): Good q — mix of both. We'll ask managers to propose reassignment suggestions; people will have the chance to opt in/out within a 2-week window. No forced moves without discussion.
Maya (Sr ML Eng): For ML infra hires: are we hiring remote-first? any preference for relocation to SFO/EU?
Evan (People Ops): Remote-first for most roles; we do have a preference to hire within supported regions (US, EU, APAC) for tax/benefits reasons. If relocation is required for a specific role we'll flag it in the JD.
Chris (Staff SWE): How will promotions/IC ladders be affected? some folks are worried about leveling during a reorg.
Ava (CEO): Leveling and promotion cadence won't be paused. We aim to be transparent — any promotion already in progress will continue. People Ops will publish an FAQ on timelines.
Priya (Head of Product): Roadmap impact: no change to key milestones for v1/v2; the reorg should reduce cross-team review time by ~20% (goal). We'll share more metrics after first sprint.
Jared (Eng Manager): Request: can we get a canonical org chart + reporting lines for the new pods? makes 1:1s easier.
Diego (VP Eng): Yes — Priya and I will publish the new org chart by EOD Friday. Expect a shared Figma + a simple markdown doc with reporting lines.
Maya (Sr ML Eng): One last ask — can we get clarity on oncall ownership for the new reliability pod vs. existing infra?
Diego (VP Eng): Reliability pod will own core SLOs and incident runbooks. Existing infra teams will keep component expertise and rotate with reliability for major incidents during the transition.
Evan (People Ops): Hiring timeline again: posts this week, first interviews start in 2–3 weeks, offers rolling starting mid-quarter. We'll post a public tracker in the hiring doc.
meeting-bot: Recording + notes from today's all-hands: https://redwood.company/ah/1792304821-recording — transcript will be up by tomorrow.
Priya (Head of Product): FAQ & hiring tracker link: https://redwood.company/docs/reorg-hiring-1792304821 — add questions here and we'll update.
Ava (CEO): Thanks for the constructive Qs. We'll check back in here after the org chart + hiring posts. If you need 1:1 time with Evan or Diego, drop a note or DM. :heart:
